map.在quality场景里，先统一 Control Chart 的输入口径，再输出可: In a quality context, first unify the input convention of the Control Chart and then output a reusable structure for quick reconciliation and review.
map.在业务流程中，先做小样本试算再扩展规模，能快速验证参数假设是否与实际口径一致。: In a business process, run a small-sample trial before scaling up, which quickly verifies whether parameter assumptions match the actual convention.
map.如何减少误用导致的偏差？: How can I reduce bias from misuse?
map.建议固定输入单位、统一日期范围，并与对照样本比对；如出现明显偏移，优先核查原始数: Fix the input units, unify the date range and compare with control samples; if a clear offset appears, check the raw data cleaning rules first.
map.当同类任务需要批量处理时，可用该工具做第一轮标准化；结果异常时再回到人工复核环节: When similar tasks must be processed in batches, use this tool for a first standardization pass; when a result looks odd, go back to manual review, which lowers the miss rate.

map.这个 quality 工具适合什么阶段使用？: What stage of work is this quality tool for?
map.适合需求澄清和第一轮评估阶段；输出可直接用于方案讨论、初筛与结果复核，但关键决策: Suitable for requirements clarification and a first round of assessment; the output can be used directly for discussion, shortlisting and result review, but key decisions should be confirmed against historical strategy.
map.逐个录入工序子组均值，工具自动绘制 X-bar 控制图并计算中心线、上下控制限（: Enter the subgroup means one by one and the tool draws an X-bar control chart and computes the centre line and the upper/lower control limits (±3σ), identifying abnormal patterns such as points outside the limits or a sustained shift, for process stability monitoring and alerting.
map.：先准备一组典型样本并固定单位与格式，运行一次并记录输出；再切换到边界样本（含缺: : prepare a set of typical samples first, fix the units and format, run once and record the output; then switch to boundary samples (missing items, outliers) to see whether the results stay explainable, forming a reviewable analysis checklist.
